item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 23 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 23 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 10 September 2026(Thursday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan(Dinalupihan, Hermosa, Morong, Orani, Samal).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Bataan(Abucay, Bagac, Balanga, Limay, Mariveles, Orion, Pilar) within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Bulacan(San Ildefonso, San Miguel, Dona Remedios Trinidad), Pampanga(Porac, Floridablanca, Lubao) and Tarlac(Mayantoc, San Jose, Capas) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
